headline: Rest today after short sleep and a loaded weekend
summary: Sleep was 5h 40m and readiness is 35. After Saturday’s 18 km run and Sunday’s 41.7 km ride, take full rest today.

recommendation.title: Full rest from training
details: No running, cycling, strength work or make-up mileage today.
Normal daily walking is enough; prioritise food, fluids and an earlier night.
Reassess after tomorrow’s completed overnight record.
recommendation.alternative: Complete rest. If you feel fresh, limit optional movement to 15–20 minutes of easy walking or gentle mobility.
recommendation.reduce_or_stop: Stop optional movement for pain that changes gait, dizziness, unusual fatigue, illness, chest symptoms or other concerning symptoms.
